notes.title: Build 3.0.55 Multiplayer Bug Fixes, Multiplayer Bug Diagnosis Tools
notes.content: We've fixed two major bugs in multiplayer that were happening when players would put the game into the background during a live match, and added a system to better recreate multiplayer bugs when they are reported by players.

notes.title: Live events are here
notes.content: We've enabled the ability to do live events and make certain IAP free for periods of time, as well as have patched a couple of bugs and put in more robust multiplayer debugging capabilities.

notes.title: Build 3.0.49 Release
notes.content: We've fixed many UI issues and bugs in this version.  In addition, we've added in functionality to allow for free multiplayer and singleplayer timed events in the future.

notes.title: Nature and 3 Expansions are free to try during the Nature Kickstarter
notes.content:
Built on the shoulders of Evolution, Nature is our new strategy game where you must adapt to survive in the natural world.  Modules then each add a distinct theme.  Experience the Jurassic 's power, the Arctic Tundra 's brutal cold, and the freedom of Flight . 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/e3c4c40d7cce27ef10280a39dcc8d0be75750b0a.png[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1926610/Nature/]Nature on Steam[/url]

Nature's core game is easy to learn, quick to play, and welcoming to new players. But Nature is the foundation for a world of mix and match Modules that each create deep and distinct ecosystems. We have a 10-year plan for Nature with a massive amount of content. 
 
We believed in this game enough to build out the digital game before the board game was even released.  It's free right now until October 23rd.  Please be sure to check out the Nature Kickstarter as well for early access to all the Modules, the Campaign, and free promo cards.  


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/northstargames/nature-a-standalone-game-in-the-evolution-series?ref=ezx5qd]Nature Kickstarter[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/0a5fb4e4bc1cfbbfa9df25674256a83141fae629.png[/img]

notes.title: Build 3.0.35
notes.content:

Fixed a few outstanding UI bugs related to Fat Tissue/Cooperation Chains.

notes.title: Multiplayer Bug Fixes

notes.title: Build 3.0.22
notes.content:
Added new custom cursor.
Fixed bugs in Climate and Flight Tutorials
Fixed bugs with Intelligence and Flight Traits

notes.title: Flight is released!
notes.content:
Evolution: Flight, an expansion for Evolution, introduces flying species into the ecosystem. Now your species can swoop on unsuspecting prey from above, fly away from predators, or soar to a new location when food is scarce.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/78f3a26edbb326bf24e6352f31d56b4f8fc39f09.png[/img]
Flight opens an array of strategic options as you've always got the option to make a flying species. The Cliffs introduce a new food source only accessible to Flying Species.  Gain control of the skies and the Cliffs are yours alone.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/d3c5febf7368d05f5f8e3f3b972bdfe3c295279e.png[/img]

6 new Traits add thematic (and seemingly overpowered!) Trait combinations when paired with Flight, but many come with tradeoffs. A flock of Brood Parasites with Nesting gives extra Population and Food, but leaves your Species defenseless.   
Will the ability to fly propel you to new heights, or will it bring your downfall?

notes.title: Bug fixes for the intelligence trait and multiplayer games.
notes.content:
[list]Fixes to the intelligence trait and double clicking errors.
[*]Fixes in multiplayer when cards are replayed to different spots.  
[/list]

notes.title: Climate Multiplayer Bug Fixes
notes.content: With the increase in Climate Matchmade Games, we've found and patched a couple of pesky bugs in the multiplayer.

notes.title: The final Trait Pack in Evolution has arrived
notes.content:
AntiSocial Species refuse to join the group, and find their own Food where the herd doesn't go. An Apex Predator adds a Carnivore and massive Size, but is unable to attack small Species.  A Carnivore may attack Quills once, however it will never make that mistake again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/b421a239e40692089cc001ed2d23bea3e9bba2b8.png[/img]

You can add any combination of these cards to AI games, or make your own deck for Pass & Play and Private games. You can also add one to public multiplayer games, which is then added into the combined deck everyone plays from.

In addition, when you invite folks to your private game, they are able to also use any purchases or expansions you have active.

notes.title: The Daily Challenge is released, multiplayer is updated.
notes.content:
This is a fun one.  Each day, you get one attempt to set a high score the Daily Challenge.  The Daily Challenge is a one-round user-designed challenge with Cards from any Promo Pack or Expansion.  It only takes a few minutes to play, and gives everyone a shot at the leaderboard, you don't have to grind to make it.  

In addition, there's a Challenge Editor feature in there to create new Daily Challenges.  Create your best challenge and submit it, and others can play it and rate it.  The highest rated challenges will then become a Daily Challenge for others to test themselves against.  

We've also updated our multiplayer with a new backend system that we hope will be much more robust at handling folks dropping games and timing out, along with other various bug fixes.  

Check back every day for the days' new challenge and set a record for having the highest average placement each day of the week.  Enjoy both of these new features!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/26c32fca45cd8386faad6ce1f3f0474e8ac1161f.png[/img]

notes.title: Climate Board Game Released!
notes.content:
Experience the fury of the elements as the climate swings between deadly heat and epic ice ages. Climate is the sequel to Evolution, adding another layer of strategy as you protect your Species from extreme temperatures as well as starvation and carnivores.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/6aa714a880ee027960e2a537c260f98a8a2b0602.png[/img]

Adaptations like cooling frills and large-scale migrations will protect your species over eons of time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/7eb95f9456103e6697fea8abe2a07a057e478b52.png[/img]

Devastating events drive an epic narrative that is unique to each game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/f416dc9414fc8788848fa537967b170e829032c6.jpg[/img]

Purchase Evolution: CLIMATE during its launch and receive the exclusive Striped Gorgonops Avatar. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/257984d7c6a3cd7cb9b5b615893668b89435e501.png[/img] 

Game Features Include
•	It's own Cross-platform Multiplayer Matchmaking
•	Asynchronous Play
•	Pass & Play
•	Expert AI

notes.title: New Multiplayer System and Async is Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/9d58de4e0f842c8ffe9fffb143cad8f1ecf89dc8.png[/img]

Asynchronous Play is out of beta!  Asynchronous means turns can happen whenever you're able.  Get interrupted by your annoying boss?  Get back to the game after the zoom call.  Want to play with your friend in Australia but it's 3 in the morning there?  No problem.  Play anywhere, anytime without needing to be online at the same time.

We've heard your concerns on making sure multiplayer is bulletproof. Our lead developer has rebuilt the mutliplayer system from the ground up, with a robust architecture capable of always recovering the game state. Jump online and give it a try!

notes.title: All New Promo Cards now available as a bundle in Promo Pack 1
notes.content:
Three more new traits have arrived at the Watering Hole, to complete Promo Pack 1.  We've heard your concerns about buying Cards individually, so we've put all of the Promo Cards together in a discounted pack.  You will get the discount and the bundle for the remaining cards even if you've already purchased Venom or Gigantism.  

These traits are completely optional, but will help make the game experience fresh for our longtime players,  in both singleplayer and multiplayer.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/175ab1266b11d20fa5b682dbd27048eedb26208e.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Timid: Sometimes being careful pays off! This shy Trait is invulnerable to attack as it stays hidden until everyone else has eaten.
[*]Insectivore: Insectivores find bugs among the plants, giving them the ability to eat massive amounts of food.
[*]Trampling: Controlling the Food supply can be more powerful than any Carnivore.  Squash excess food when it suits you with Trampling!
[/list]


Promo Cards and Balance
You don't need to have any of these cards to play Evolution, these are simply to enhance the experience and provide new ways to play.  We wanted to make sure they don't give any advantage in multiplayer, so all players in a multiplayer game get to use them when they are added to the deck.  We hope you enjoy this new content.

notes.title: New Traits are here and enabled for multiplayer
notes.content:
Our biggest addition since launch:  New Promo Traits are now available for purchase in the game.  In a balanced ecosystem, each new Trait impacts all other Traits as well.  You'll need new strategies to survive against creatures using these mighty traits. Buy them on Steam, use them on any platform.  Use them:
•	Against the AI in single-player games
•	In your own custom private games
•	In public match-made multiplayer games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/ad24690587d49b90751d16287148314ffa46ed66.png[/img]

Public Multiplayer "Find A Match" 
You can also use your promo cards in match-made multiplayer. Here's how it works: each player is allowed to add one promo card to the deck for everyone to use (the others do not need to own the promo card).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/bc5a5759bc6f044fb0507d64d0d39caa6a98a6e9.png[/img]

No Bots in Multiplayer
 
By popular request, match-made multiplayer will no longer use computer opponents by default. You've told us they take the human element out of multiplayer games. Public games will have a three person minimum before they kick off.  

As always, join us in Discord to let us know what you think, discuss strategies, and beta test future cards.

https://discord.com/invite/JencA3p?mc_cid=cb6caa7fbd&mc_eid=%5BUNIQID%5D

notes.title: Singleplayer Challenge Mode is here!
notes.content:
This is the biggest update to [i]Evolution[/i] since launch.  

Can you beat the Evolution Board Game using each trait only once? Can you win without eating from the Watering Hole?    See how adaptable you really are in these challenges that require you to play a different way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/a31a5fd4164111edd325d730b05e8cc79735fa4a.png[/img]

Test yourself by attempting to earn Bronze, Silver, or the ludicrous Gold Medal Achievements. Think you're the best at this week's challenge? Prove it on the new leaderboards. Mastered this week's challenge? There's a new challenge next week.  Make sure you're updated to build 1.16.03,  and find them in the local games menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/275ea59e1feb764ac5c60c90d6af5479638478d5.png[/img]

notes.title: Elo Rankings Get Real
notes.content:
Big changes are going into effect for the start of the October Tournament today.   Yes, we've got a gorgeous new Hackbill avatar for you Nobel Laureates to covet, but we're also making two changes to Elo's:

1.  Elo penalties for quitting games-  Players intentionally leaving a game will be treated as a forfeit in elo scores.  This should help stop the bad behavior of folks abandoning games early to avoid a loss.

2.  Elo's adjusted at the start of each Tournament-  By popular demand, we're adjusting Elo's at the start of each tournament.  All player's will start the new tourney each month with their elo adjusted halfway back to 1500.   If you finished the September tourney with an elo of 1900, you'll start the October tourney with an elo of 1700.  If you didn't play in September, you'll start at 1500.  This should allow new players to climb to the top of the elo leaderboard, and ensure only active players can win a tournament.

Note-  Elo Leaderboards are not visible in the live game just yet.  Those of you in the beta can see them, and you're still welcome to join!  (see instructions at the top of #betaannouncements in [url=https://discord.gg/XWBq5K4]Discord[/url]).  You can also still see your elo on our [url=https://evolution.community.gl/]old website[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270933/848f175bfc1670f9ba944fd4c57355528c96a247.jpg[/img]

notes.title: October's exclusive avatar is here, the Hackbill.
notes.content:
Happy October, Explorers!  It’s a new month, and we’ve got an exciting field assignment for you!  This month, we’ll be searching for and documenting the elusive Hackbill! This incredible species has an enormous growth on its bill and dazzling plumage to impress his potential mates, and rows of sharp teeth for shredding its prey.  For the entire month of October, you’ll have the opportunity to compete in Multiplayer and climb your way through the academic ranks to Nobel Laureate! When you reach the top, the Hackbill avatar will be added to your sketchbook avatar collection.  Don’t miss out on this exclusive design, available only for those making Nobel this month.

notes.title: Hotseat Play is here
notes.content:
The long awaited Hotseat/ Pass and Play mode has arrived!  
[list]
[*] Up to four players can play a local multiplayer game on the same device.   
[*] Swap players in the hotseat for trait play.

notes.title: June Tournament Begins, New Exclusive Avatar
notes.content:
Hey All, 
We've got a beautiful new avatar for anyone that makes it to the top of the rankings in June, the Harpy Eagle.  To earn this predator, work your way to rank 1, Nobel Laureates, before June 30th.   As a reminder, each singleplayer win earns you one Discovery up until rank 15, and a multiplayer win can earn as many as five discoveries to move up quickly.   For players already in the Tournament Ranks, ranks 1-9, you'll start the new tourney at rank 9. Good luck, and Adapt well!

North Star

notes.title: Multiplayer Changes, April Tournament Begins, Ultrawide Support
notes.content:
[b]Ranking Changes [/b]

We’ve made some much requested changes to rankings:

We added rank numbers and a rank ladder into the game, so you can see right where you stand.  

We’ve made it so in multiplayer games, if a person leaves, the remaining players automatically will receive a Discovery for a win over them. 

We’ve also fixed a lot of multiplayer bugs, including that nasty “unmatchable” bug that made it so some folks couldn’t match.  

[b]April Tournament Begins[/b]

The new month brings a start to a new seasonal tournament.  All players in the Tournament Ranks (ranks 1-9)  will start the new tournament at rank 6 or rank 9.   We've added a new exclusive avatar in for those that make it to rank #1, Nobel Laureate, in the April Tourney.   To permanently add the new avatar to your collection each month, prove your skill by climbing to the top of the rankings! 

[b]Ultrawide Support[/b]
We now fill the full screen for Ultrawide Monitors

notes.title: The March Tournament Ends Soon, Last Chance to Earn the Baboon Avatar
notes.content: Ten days left to make your way up the rankings to Nobel Laureate!   All players making it to Nobel by March 31st will receive this Season's exclusive Baboon Avatar.  A new monthly tournament will begin April 1st, and with it we'll introduce an updated rank ladder and some much needed changes to multiplayer.

notes.title: Multiplayer Stability Fixes
notes.content: Big news!   We believe we just solved most of our critical multiplayer bugs, and we have implemented the fixes live on the server as of yesterday (no client update needed).   Multiplayer should be much more stable!  With this, we believe we have fixed all known multiplayer issues, so please let us know if you have any crashes or hangs.  There is still a latent bug where certain accounts are unable to match with others, we're working on this one.  Please use the feedback button in game to capture a screenshot, and share as much context as you can if you do run into something.   Thanks for playing!
